results.note: A cluster of red and green autumn leaves on a sapling; the central leaves show their full lobed outline, but neighbours crowd them and the toothed edge needs close study. Autumn colour gives growth_stage autumn.
A leafy branch of green mature leaves with red petioles; the three-lobed outlines read, but leaves overlap and crowd each other and the fine teeth are small in the frame.
Autumn-coloured leaves on a twig with the opposite petiole joins visible; the top leaf outline is whole, but a busy red background of leaves competes and the teeth are small.
A whole trunk shot from a distance in a spring landscape; the bark is small in the frame and largely covered by moss, so texture, pattern and colour need close study.
A mass of yellow foreground leaves against sky with a red-crowned tree behind; no single leaf reads, the margins are not visible, and the sunlit/backlit yellow foliage blends into a mass.
A sapling in a meadow scene with red and orange autumn leaves; the leaves are small and blend into the surrounding vegetation, so no outline or margin can be read.
One whole green three-lobed leaf hangs from a red petiole against a soft background; the outline, toothed edge and veins read clearly, and the pale surface suggests the underside.
A smooth grey lichen-spotted trunk in an autumn forest, shot from a distance; the texture and pattern are small in the frame. The smooth grey bark is a young form.
A multi-stemmed trunk with furrowed, scaly old bark; the ridges read clearly, but sun backlights the fork and shades the trunk, which darkens the colour.
A sharp close-up of grey, lichen-flecked bark with long scaly ridges and narrow furrows; the frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale.
A single fallen red leaf lying in brown leaf litter with a mushroom; its lobed outline and teeth read, but the subject is a dead fallen leaf.
A wide trunk with shaggy, peeling vertical plates and a trunk edge in view; a hand at the left gives scale and does not cover the bark pattern.
A close-up of grey scaly bark with deep vertical furrows; the centre is sharp and the corners soften with the lens, and the frame shows texture only.
A straight grey trunk with long, narrow, curling vertical plates, both trunk edges in frame; the pattern repeat reads clearly.
One whole red-and-green autumn leaf in front of hemlock and leaf litter; the lobed outline and toothed edge read clearly, and the leaf stands out from the busy background.
The camera looks up a trunk into the crown with a birdhouse and a strong sun flare; the bark is foreshortened and washed out, and the birdhouse draws the eye.
Backlit orange-red autumn leaves hang in a crowded spray with soft focus; the outlines can be traced but need study, and the backlight shifts the colour.
A large red-and-green autumn leaf fills the frame with sharp lobes, teeth and veins; the left lobe tip meets the frame edge and other leaves crowd around it.
A small trunk whose smooth grey bark is starting to crack into thin vertical strips, with trunk edges in view; this is the young, transitional bark form.
A carpet of fallen red, pink and brown leaves on the ground; single outlines are small among many, and the subject is dead fallen leaves.
Pale pinkish samaras hang among new leaves, seen from below against bright sky. The samaras crowd with the leaves and are backlit, so the outline needs study; pale colour suggests unripe fruit.
Close view of paired green-pink samaras against a dark soft background. The wings are clear; the attachment to the twig is only partly shown, and the green colour marks them as unripe.
Red samara clusters hang on long stalks from a bare twig against plain blue sky. Kind, shape, and hang are all easy to read.
Sunlit clusters of red samaras hang from a twig; the background is soft. The samaras overlap a little but the wing shape is easy to read.

Greenish-red samaras hang on long stalks from a twig in warm low sun against a soft background. The samaras are fairly small and overlap, so the shape needs study, and the warm light shifts the colour.
Frame-filling close-up of grey shaggy bark with long scaly plates and dark furrows. It shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale object.
Clusters of pink-green samaras hang on red stalks from a twig, with new leaves softly behind. Their green-pink colour marks them as unripe.
The lower trunk stands in a lawn, with smooth grey bark above and shallow scaly furrows near the base. The photo is taken from a distance, so the fine texture needs close study.
A single hanging lobed leaf, lit by flash against a black background. The outline and margin are clear, but the flash makes the colour pale grey-green.
Tiny red-winged young samaras, just past flowering, sit on upright green stalks against a soft background. The wings are only starting to form, so the fruit kind and shape need close study.
A scan of one whole green five-lobed leaf with its petiole, on a black background. Every key feature is easy to read.
One whole green lobed leaf lies on wood mulch. The leaf dominates the frame, and its outline and margin are clear.
Dense clusters of red-orange samaras hang from pale branches, lit by flash against black. The clusters are dense and small in the frame, and the flash shifts the colour.
A close cluster of pinkish samaras hangs on red stalks, with soft green leaves behind. The wings are clear; the green-pink colour marks the fruit as unripe.
Frame-filling close-up of grey-brown bark with scaly, flaking plates and shallow furrows. It shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale object.
Orange autumn crown seen from below; the leaves blend into a mass. No single leaf outline or margin can be read.
Several green lobed leaves hang on a branch, seen from below, with a busy park background. The leaves are tilted and compete with each other; brown spots do not change the outline.
Many red samara clusters on bare branches, seen from below against a pine and the sky. Each cluster is small in a busy frame, so kind and shape need close study.

Very young red samaras, just past flowering, droop on long red stalks from a twig, backlit against overcast sky. The wings are tiny and dark, so kind and shape need close study; the structures are borderline with flowers.
Fallen red-yellow spotted autumn leaves lie overlapping on the ground. The subject is dead fallen leaves, and other leaves cover part of the central one.

One whole green leaf seen from beneath against a soft background of foliage. A second leaf overlaps at the right and competes, so alone is false; the petiole runs to the frame top, so arrangement needs a search.
Trunk with both edges in frame showing shaggy grey plates curling at the edges; clear and readable.
Trunk at a slight upward view with a building behind; furrowed plates with loose edges are clear.
Single whole green leaf with petiole on a plain white background; lobes and margin clear. No twig, so arrangement is not shown.
Camera looks straight up the trunk into the crown, so the bark is foreshortened and the pattern needs study; reject for looking up.
Trunk filling the frame with edges visible; long vertical plates and furrows are clear.
A sapling in a garden bed among other plants; leaves blend into a mass and no single leaf margin can be read.
A whole sapling in a yard with shrubs behind; leaves blend into a mass and margins are not readable.

A twig with leaves and a dense cluster of paired samaras hanging on long stalks, on a black background. Seeds are still green so the fruit is unripe; the crowded cluster makes single samara outlines need a search.
View up into an orange autumn crown; leaves blend into a mass and no single margin is readable.
Old, gnarled trunk seen from a distance with moss; the plate pattern is small in the frame and needs study.
Trunk with edges in frame and buildings behind; long plates with lifting edges are clear.
Large forked trunk in winter sun with lichen and moss; the scaly plate pattern reads clearly.
Close frame of bark texture only, no trunk edge or scale. Warm reddish tones shift the colour away from the usual grey.
Multi-stemmed old trunk seen from a distance in an autumn forest; bark pattern is small in frame and dappled sun and shade change the tones.
A single ripe, brown double samara with stalk on a plain background with a 1 cm scale bar; detached, so hang is not shown.
Close frame of furrowed grey bark with lichen, no trunk edge or scale; texture and ridges are clear.
Close frame of grey bark with long plates lifting at the edges; no trunk edge or scale object.
Trunk with both edges in frame, lichen patches and a thin vine; furrowed plate pattern is clear.
Fallen autumn leaves in yellow, orange and brown lying in a crowded pile on the ground; the subject is dead leaf litter, so it is a reject.

A single fallen samara half lying on snow and germinating, with a root showing. It is a sharp, clear samara, but a lone, sprouting seed is not the typical paired fruit on the tree, so atypical and after seed fall.
A wide trunk with both edges in the frame, showing grey, scaly, blocky plates in even light. Clear and typical.
Lobed leaves shot from below against the sky. The central leaf outline reads well, but the leaves crowd and overlap, and the backlit view from below changes the colour.
One lobed leaf against a dark background with clear rounded lobes and veins. The frame cuts off the base, and the harsh flash-like light makes the leaf look grey-blue.
A leafy branch with small green acorns, shot from below against bright sky. The leaves crowd and overlap, so one outline takes a search, and the backlight with sun from below makes it harder.
A drooping branch with many overlapping lobed leaves over a lawn. The leaves crowd, so a learner must search for one whole outline.
A cluster of dry, brown paired samaras hanging on long stalks from a bare twig, with a soft background. The warm low sun lights them from behind and warms the colour.
Two ripe acorns on a plain blue background with a 1 cm scale bar, one with its warty cap and one without. Sharp and clear.
Wet branches of rounded-lobed leaves over pine straw. Several whole outlines read well, but the many leaves crowd one another.
Green acorns with warty caps sit on a twig among lobed leaves. They have their full shape but are not ripe, so unripe and not the usual look.
A trunk with scaly, plated bark and its edges in the frame. Patches of sun and deep shade change the colour across the trunk.
A trunk in a forest with both edges in view, showing small blocky grey plates. Clear, even light.
A light grey trunk with its edges in view, showing shallow scaly plates. Clear and typical.
The camera looks up the forked trunk into a backlit crown. The bark is far away and in shade, so the texture is hard to read, and this is a bark_up_or_dark reject.
Paired samaras with green seeds and tan wings hanging on long stalks, against a soft background. Full shape but not ripe.
A lobed leaf with several holes and a row of yellow galls near the tip. Other leaves crowd it, and the frame cuts off its base.
A green acorn with a warty cap, shown close up behind the edge of a leaf. Full shape but not ripe, and the leaf hides how it sits on the twig.

A dense cluster of green-seeded samaras on a twig with leaves, shot with flash against a black background. The samaras are small and overlap, so one shape takes a search, and the flash changes the colour.
A cluster of deeply lobed leaves at a twig tip, with the stalks joining the twig in view. The outlines are clear, but other leaves crowd the background.
A large trunk with both edges in view, showing long, loose, shaggy plates. Clear and typical.
One green acorn with its warty cap, sitting on the twig among leaves. The acorn has its full shape but is green, so it is unripe and not the usual look.
Dead brown leaves on the ground in a crowded pile. The subject is a dead leaf, which is a reject, and low sun casts hard shadows.
A cluster of green acorns with warty caps, sitting on the twig among leaves. The front acorn shows in full. They have full shape but are green, so unripe.
One whole lobed leaf with bristle-tipped lobes, seen from below against the light. Backlight and the low view from below make it harder; a few small spots do not change the outline.
A large trunk base in full, with grey ridges and furrows clearly visible and trunk edges in frame. A small tag on the trunk is not readable.
A cluster of new spring leaves with catkins, overlapping one another. The leaves are young and not at full shape, and strong sunlight shines through them.
The camera looks up the trunk into the crown, and the trunk is dark against the bright sky. This is a reject for bark looking up and dark.
Many overlapping green lobed leaves on a branch, none standing alone. Crowding puts shape at search, and dappled sun and shade change the colour.
Three green acorns with warty caps sitting on the twig. Full shape but green, so unripe.
A small shoot of leaves growing straight from the trunk, an epicormic sucker shoot, with shallow rounded lobes unlike the typical leaf. A sucker leaf is a reject.
A whorl of green lobed leaves seen from above over the forest floor. The lobes read well, but the bristle tips on the margin are small in the frame.
New yellow-green spring leaves with hanging catkins, backlit by the sun. The leaves are young and not at full shape, and backlight changes the colour.
A crown of red autumn leaves where the leaves blend into a mass and no single leaf stands out. This is a leaf-mass reject.
A cluster of yellow-orange autumn leaves on a sapling with only shallow lobes, which is not the typical deeply lobed form. Strong sun brightens the colour.
A branch of red autumn leaves against a soft background, with leaves overlapping and somewhat soft. Crowding and softness put shape and margin at search.
Green lobed leaves on a low shoot, crowded together with the central leaf readable. Dappled sun and shade change the colour; a small hole does not change the outline.
Several ripening acorns with warty caps, the nuts pink-brown. Flash on a dark background changes the colour.
A branch of green lobed leaves with bristle tips, several overlapping. Crowding means no single leaf stands alone.
A whole small tree with red autumn foliage in a conifer landscape. The main subject is the crown, so the part is other.
The camera looks straight up the trunk into the crown; the ridges of the lower trunk are readable. Looking up into the crown is a bark reject.
View up into a crown of yellowing autumn leaves against a pale sky; the leaves blend into a mass, seen from below and backlit.
Sharp close-up of mature bark with interlacing narrow ridges filling the frame; no trunk edge or scale object, so too close.
Section of a flowering crown with many overlapping leaves and orange flowers; leaf outlines are small and crowded, so shape and margin need a search.
Trunk with fine interlacing furrows and lichen patches against a sharp street scene; the busy background competes and the fine furrow pattern is partly hidden by lichen.
Close, sharp view of one ripe brown acorn with its scaly cap hanging from its stalk on a soft background.
Studio shot of ripe acorns and a loose cap on a black background, one capped acorn in side view; not on the twig, so hang is not shown.
Branch tip with several full four-lobed leaves around a terminal shoot; the central leaves are clear but neighbouring leaves crowd the frame, and the stalk joins are only partly visible.
Low shoot among ground vegetation with deeply, irregularly multi-lobed leaves typical of a sucker or seedling shoot, not the mature leaf form; other plants crowd the frame.
A green, unripe upright cone of samaras sits at the centre among many backlit leaves seen from below; the cone is small in the frame and its kind is hard to recognise while green.
Close-up of ridged, plated bark filling the frame with no trunk edge; warm low sun tints the colour.
Mature trunk with both edges in frame showing long flat-topped ridges and shallow furrows in even light.
Newly emerging leaves on a shoot tip against the sky, still folded and not at full shape, so the outline needs close study.
Studio shot of a capped acorn, a cut nut, and a nut seen from the base on a plain blue background with a 1 cm scale bar.
One whole green four-lobed leaf with a notched tip on a dark plain background; a few small spots do not change the outline.
View up into the edge of a crown against blue sky in warm low sun; the small leaves blend into a mass.
Flowering branch with two tulip flowers and several clear four-lobed leaves on a dark soft background; the flowers compete with the leaves for attention.
Several green, full-shape acorns with caps sitting on twigs among leaves; not yet ripe, and the leaves compete in the frame.
One whole green four-lobed leaf held over a dark ground with fallen yellow leaves; the pale surface with raised veins looks like the underside.
Branches crowded with flowers and many overlapping leaves; a few leaf outlines can be traced but the crowding means the shape needs a search.
Five ripe acorns with their caps on a plain white surface; not on the twig, so hang is not shown.
View from below into a crown of bare twigs with scattered yellowing leaves and many small fruit cones against the sky; no single part is the subject, so the part is other.
Close frame of old bark with interlacing ridges and lichen, showing the pattern repeat clearly; no trunk edge or scale, so too_close.
Mature trunk with both edges in frame and clear interlacing furrows; the background is soft.
Base of a huge old trunk in forest seen from a distance, in deep shade; the furrows are visible only with study, so texture and pattern are at search and light is a cause.
Frosted cones of samaras on a winter twig against a soft blue background; the central cone is intact while the others have shed most samaras, so after seed fall.
Several trunks in a leafless woodland seen from a distance with branch shadows across the bark; the furrows need study and the other trunks compete.
Two opened cones of samaras on a twig, small in the frame, against a busy autumn-coloured crown that competes; kind and shape need study.
The camera looks up the trunk into the green crown, with dappled light on the bark; looking up into the crown is a reject.
One weathered, partly shed cone of samaras upright on a bare twig against a soft blue background.
Top view of a shed fruit cone, a rosette of remaining samaras over snow; the top view hides the cone outline, so kind and shape need study.
Close frame of furrowed bark covered in yellow lichen; the ridges are clear, but there is no trunk edge or scale, and the lichen hides the bark colour.
One whole brown cone of samaras on a short stalk, lit by flash against a black background; it is not shown on a twig.
Two children stand in front of a large old trunk and compete with it; the furrows show above them in mixed shade and sun and need study.
Mature trunk filling the frame with both edges visible and clear interlacing furrows with pale ridges.
Straight mature trunk with clear interlacing furrows and both edges in frame against a dark background.
Mature trunk with clear interlacing ridges and pale furrows, both edges in frame against sky and foliage.
A whole bleached, weathered fruit cone lies on the ground among debris and clover that compete; its faded, fallen form is not the typical look.
An opened cone of samaras with spreading scales hangs on a stalk in front of a soft autumn background; the attachment to the twig is unclear.
A ripe brown cone of samaras, starting to open, sits upright on a twig against a soft green background.
A green, full-size but unripe fruit cone sits upright on a twig among leaves; the samaras are not yet separate, so the kind needs study and no wings show.
Green sycamore leaf seen from below against the light; the bottom lobe tip reaches the frame edge and other leaves crowd the top. Backlight and the view from below make the teeth harder to read.
A leafy sycamore shoot against a dark, busy background; the top two leaves are whole but several leaves crowd the frame. The teeth are small at this size.

A shoot of several leaves, seen from below against a bright sky, with many turned red, brown, and orange. The backlight, the low angle, and the crowding make the leaves harder to read, and the autumn colour is not the usual look.
The camera looks up into the crown at a white, mottled upper trunk, with bare branches crossing it against a blue sky. The mottling reads well, but the upward view into the crown makes it a reject.
A whole sycamore leaf on its twig against a dark background, with clear coarse teeth. The leaf is backlit, which changes its colour.
A whole green sycamore leaf, upper side, on a grass background, with a neighbouring leaf cut off at the left. The outline and teeth read clearly, but the petiole runs off the frame.
A hand holds two overlapping sycamore leaves over the trunk base and the leaf litter. The overlap hides part of each outline, so neither leaf is whole, and the busy background competes with them.
A whole sycamore leaf on its twig, shot with flash against a black background. Leaves with brown blotches sit above it and compete, and the flash changes the colour.

The persistent tulip-shaped ring of a tuliptree cone of samaras, sitting upright on its stalk against snow. Most samaras have fallen, so the fruit is in its after-seed-fall stage and not the usual look.
A close-up of mottled, flaking bark in patches of green, white, and red-brown. The pattern is very clear, but the frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale object.
A sycamore trunk base on a street verge, with cars and a road around it. The bark is seen from a distance, so its texture and pattern need close study, and the scene competes with the trunk.

Bare tuliptree twigs seen from below against a blue sky, holding small dark, open cones of samaras after seed fall. The fruits are small in the frame and show as silhouettes, and the twigs compete with them.
A whole green sycamore leaf, upper side, crowded by the leaves around it, with a young flower or fruit head on the twig. The small insect holes do not change the outline.
A sycamore sapling or thicket in sun, with the leaves blending into a mass in front of taller trees. No single leaf margin can be read at this size.
The camera looks up into a bare winter crown with mottled upper branches. The bark is distant, and a tangle of twigs competes with it.

An old multi-stemmed sycamore with a hollow base and white, mottled stems, surrounded by dense green growth. The mottled pattern reads well, but the texture is distant and the vegetation competes with it.
A cut sycamore shoot laid on grey deck boards, upper side, with alternate leaves along the stem. The top leaves are whole, with clear lobes and teeth.
A sycamore trunk with peeling plates over pale inner bark, crossed by two branches in front. The warm, soft light gives the photo a slightly warm cast, but it still looks natural.
A dark-speckled sycamore leaf in shade, crowded by other leaves. A leaf at the lower left overlaps part of its outline, and the deep shade dulls the colour.
A whole, light green sycamore leaf with a blotchy surface against plain gravel. The blotches do not change the outline, and the lobes and teeth read clearly.
One green seed ball on its stalk against a leaf. It is full size but green with style remnants, so it is unripe. The twig is out of frame, so hang is search.

Upper side of one lobed leaf held in a hand, with other leaves crowding behind. The frame edge cuts off the lower lobe tip and the right edge, and a lesion and a gall-like patch mark the right lobe edge. Platanus ×hispanica is the tree itself, so the photo passes.
The camera looks up into a bare crown of white limbs against the sky. The white bark colour shows, but the texture is far off and the view from below is a reject.
Many small seed balls in a bare crown, seen from below and far off. The balls are small in the frame, so the key features are search.
Five brown seed balls hang on long single stalks from a bare twig against a plain blue sky. A clean, typical view.
A close view of the mottled bark with grey, cream, and green patches and a small swelling. It shows no trunk edge and no scale object, so it is too close.
A fallen brown seed ball lies on a log, with a broken piece of another ball behind it. It is off the twig, so hang is no.
The base of a large trunk by a street curb, with a car and lawn in the frame. The bark is seen from a distance, so texture and pattern are search.
A small young seed ball with styles still showing hangs on its stalk from a twig beside a new leaf. It has not reached full size, so it is young.
A trunk with mottled, peeling patches, framed by leaves that crowd the foreground. The trunk edges show.
A scene of an avenue of trees over a path, with no leaf, bark, or fruit as the subject. Platanus ×hispanica is the tree itself, so identity passes.
One yellow-green seed ball hangs on a long stalk from a bare twig, with other balls soft in the background. The ball is full size but still green, so it is unripe.
A green seed ball on its stalk against a soft background of autumn leaves. It is full size but green, so it is unripe. The twig is blurred, so hang is search.
A whole trunk with white upper limbs, shot up into the crown with leaves around it. The camera looks up into the crown, and the bark texture is far off.
A broken-up seed ball on a log: a brown core with a ring of hairy achenes spread out, seen from above. The ball is not in its typical form, so it is atypical, and the kind needs close study.
Many brown seed balls hang on single stalks from bare twigs against a plain blue sky. A clean, typical view.
A seed ball that is breaking apart, with the hairy achenes spilling out of one side, hanging against a soft background. The broken ball is atypical, so its outline is search.
One green seed ball hangs on a long stalk from a bare twig with buds, against a soft grey background. The ball is full size but green, so it is unripe.
A trunk with peeling brown plates over cream underbark, in a busy winter woodland. The background competes, so alone is false.
A close view of one ripe brown seed ball against a soft winter background. Only the top of the stalk shows, so hang is search.

A crowded branch of green leaves seen from below against bright sky, with one seed ball hanging; leaves overlap so outlines and edges need a search, the view from below is an unusual angle, and backlight changes the colour.
Trunk with typical mottled, flaking plates in brown, grey and cream; both trunk edges show against a soft background.
Overlapping green leaves seen from below beside a mottled trunk that competes for attention; strong backlight washes out the leaves, so outlines and edges need a search.
Trunk with clear camouflage patches of brown plates over cream and green inner bark; trunk edges show against sky and a soft winter background.
Close frame of old scaly bark with small plates, texture only with no trunk edge or scale; strong side light and deep shadow on the right change the colour.
Narrow trunk with typical mottled peeling patches; both edges show against a plain wall.
Close frame of vivid camouflage bark with green, yellow and brown patches; texture only, with no trunk edge or scale object.
A dead brown fallen leaf on grass among other dead leaves; the outline reads, but the subject is a dead leaf.
The camera looks up a large forked trunk into the bare crown against bright sky; the bark is backlit and dark, so the pattern needs a search.
Trunk with clear white, grey-green and tan mottled patches; both edges show against soft green foliage.
Close frame of smooth bark with a few peeling plate outlines; too small an area to show the patch repeat, and warm low sun with deep shadow changes the colour.
A green lobed leaf hangs in front of a mottled trunk; the frame edge cuts off the right lobe and another leaf covers the top, and the trunk competes, so the outline needs a search.
A street scene with an avenue of planetrees, cars and cyclists; no single leaf, bark or fruit is the subject.
Branch of leaves with several hanging seed balls seen from below against blue sky; leaves are small and overlapping so outlines need a search, and the view from below with backlight is harder.
A green lobed leaf held in a hand with its toothed lobes clear; the hand covers the base and the top lobe tip runs to the frame edge, so it is not whole. Small pale spots do not change the outline.
A dense mass of overlapping leaves in the crown; no single leaf stands out, the outlines blend and the edges cannot be read.
One whole green lobed leaf with toothed lobes against a dark soft background; the stalk runs to a twig with smaller leaves at lower left.
A sprig of green lobed leaves in sharp focus in front of a soft mottled trunk that competes for attention; a film scan with a slight warm cast, not heavy enough to look unreal.
A pale trunk with small scaly plates outlined by fine cracks; both edges show.
A trunk heavily covered in lichen and algae, with the right edge and a path of fallen leaves showing; the lichen hides much of the patch pattern and colour, so they need a search.
One dry brown seed ball held in a hand. Leaf litter is soft behind it. Hang is no because the hand holds the ball.
Two ripe tan seed balls hang one below the other on one stalk. Bare twigs and blue sky, so winter.
One green, full-size seed ball rests over an open hand, with large leaves around it. A large hand and the leaves compete, so alone is false. The ball is unripe.
A fallen seed ball on paving is breaking apart, and loose hairy seeds lie around it. Atypical is for the broken ball, and angle is for the top-down view. The season is a guess from the shedding.
One green spiky seed ball hangs on its stalk among green leaves. It is full size but unripe.
One green spiky seed ball hangs on a long stalk against a soft green background. It is full size but unripe.
Two or three yellow-green seed balls hang in a chain on one stalk below a leaf, so two_heads shows clearly. They are full size but not ripe.
A crown view in which the leaves blend into a mass. Only a few small seed balls show. One central leaf can be traced only with a search.

A sunlit autumn scene. One small green-yellow seed ball sits among dead brown leaves, with a trunk and a person's shadow. The ball is small in the frame, the leaves compete, and warm low sun changes the colours.
One dark brown seed ball hangs among green leaves. The view is from below with backlight, so the ball looks dark.
Several brown seed balls hang singly from bare twigs against blue sky, seen from below. The several balls compete, and the frame cuts off the lowest ball.

Several red and green autumn leaves on a branch against a grey trunk; the large red leaf at centre-left shows its lobes and toothed edge. Autumn colour so growth_stage autumn and usual_look false; neighbouring leaves compete so alone is false.
A leafy green branch in dappled light with overlapping leaves. Lower-left leaves show their lobes, but the toothed margin needs close study and the crowding makes alone false.
A twig with red, orange and green autumn leaves; the central leaves show lobes and toothed edges against a busy background. Autumn colour makes usual_look false; crowded so alone is false.

A whole mature trunk in a park, seen from a distance in a small file, with long vertical ridges partly covered in moss. The ridge pattern and true colour need close study because of the distance and moss.
A branch crowded with overlapping yellow autumn leaves, with a red tree behind. Leaf outlines and edges are only readable with close study, and several leaves are cut by the frame.
A small tree or sapling with red, orange and green leaves that blend into a mass with the grass and water behind. No single leaf shows its edge.
One whole green leaf with a red stalk against a soft background. Lobes, toothed edge and veins are all easy to read.
A grey, mostly smooth trunk with lichen patches and shallow ridging, with the trunk edge visible. The busy forest and leaf background competes, so alone is false.
A forked multi-stem trunk with grey furrowed bark. The sun behind the middle stem backlights it, so colour is harder to judge.
A sharp close-up of grey, ridged and flaking bark that fills the frame. There is no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so it is too close.
One red autumn leaf lying among brown fallen leaves, with a mushroom nearby. The lobes read well but the edge blends into the litter, so alone is false.
A small file of shaggy, flaking bark with a hand at the left edge covering a small part of the bark. The trunk edge and hand give scale.
A close-up of grey blocky ridged bark that fills the frame, sharp at the centre and a little soft at the edges. No trunk edge or scale object, so it is too close.
A full trunk with narrow vertical ridges, with both trunk edges and a soft green forest background.
A red and orange autumn leaf with clear lobes and toothed edge, hanging in front of conifer needles. The needles compete with the leaf, so alone is false.
The camera looks up a trunk toward the crown into a bright sun flare, with a birdhouse nailed to the trunk. The upward view, backlight and birdhouse make the bark hard to read.
Backlit orange and red autumn leaves that overlap and are cut by the frame, in a soft photo. Backlight changes the colour; outlines are found only with close study.
A sharp close-up of one whole leaf turning from green to red, with lobes, toothed edge and veins plain. Autumn colour makes usual_look false.
A trunk with scaly grey-brown plates and pale lichen patches. A small stick crosses it, and the trunk edges are visible.
A wide scene of fallen red, pink and brown leaves covering the ground, with no single leaf as the subject.
Samara clusters hang from a twig in a leafy spring crown. They are small in the frame and crowded by new leaves, so kind, shape and wing take close study.
Close view of paired samaras hanging on stalks against a dark soft background. The wings are green-pink and full-sized but not yet ripe red.
Red samara pairs hang from slender twigs against plain blue sky. Wing and hang are easy to read.
Dense red samara clusters hang from a twig, with a soft warm background. The pairs overlap a little but the wings and hang are readable.
Samaras on long red stalks against a soft blurred background. They are green-red and full-shaped but not ripe, hence unripe and not the usual look.
Close crop of rough, scaly, plated bark with vertical ridges and no trunk edge, so too close. Warm low sun adds a golden cast to the colour.
Samara pairs hang from red stalks with a young green leaf beside them and a soft green background. Wings and hang are clear.
Whole trunk base in a lawn with the trunk edges visible. The ridges and plates read at this distance but the fine texture takes closer study.

One whole five-lobed leaf hangs on its stalk against a black background, apparently lit by flash. The underside shows pale veins, the edge detail is hard to read, and the dark flash lighting dulls the colour.
Small, young samaras with short red wings on green stalks, mixed with leftover flower parts, against a blurred background. The fruit has not reached its full shape and is cut by the frame edge.
A whole green leaf with its stalk on a plain black background, upper side up. Outline, lobe tips, edge and veins are all clear.
A whole grey-green leaf, apparently underside up, lies on bark mulch. The outline and veins read well, but the busy mulch background competes with the leaf.
Two hanging samara clusters photographed at night against black, apparently with flash. The fruit is small in the frame, so kind, shape and wing need close study, and the flash shifts the colour.
Samara pairs hang from red stalks with a young leaf at upper left and a soft green background. Wings and hang are clear.
Close crop of grey-brown flaking, ridged bark with no trunk edge or scale object, so too close. The ridge pattern is readable only with some study.
A crown of autumn-coloured leaves fills the frame, with no single leaf, fruit or bark as the subject. The leaves blend into a mass, so the part is other.
Several green leaves with brown blotches on a branch, tilted at different angles and crowded together. The large lower-left leaf is cut by the frame edge, so its lobes and edge take close study.
Many small red samara clusters on twigs, seen from below against sky and pine needles. The fruit is small and the background is busy, so the shape and wings need close study.
Red flowers on long hanging stalks along a bare twig, against a soft sky. Flowers are the only subject, so the part is other.
Autumn-coloured leaves lie in a pile and overlap each other, with the main leaf touching the frame edge. Lobes and edge can be traced only with study.

One large green leaf seen from its underside and slightly tilted, with other leaves overlapping behind and at right. The tilted view is the angle cause and the overlapping leaves keep it from standing alone.
A whole trunk with both edges in frame, showing deep ridges and plates. The park background is soft and does not compete.
A trunk with its edges visible and clear ridges and plates. A brick building behind it is out of the way.
One whole green leaf on a plain white ground, upper side, with the outline, lobe tips and veins easy to read. No stalk-to-twig join and no scale object.
An old trunk shot from the base looking up into the limbs and crown. The upward camera angle is the reject, and it also bends the ridge pattern.
A whole trunk in front of a brick building, with ridges and plates readable and both trunk edges in frame.
A whole sapling in a garden among hostas, with a fence and house behind. The leaves are small and blend into a mass, so the lobes and the margin cannot be read.
A whole sapling in front of a hedge with hostas below. The leaves are small and run together, and no single leaf outline or margin is readable.
Paired samaras hang from a leafy twig against black. Their green seed bodies mean they are not yet ripe, and the flash on black changes the colours.
A crown full of orange autumn leaves that blend into one mass. No single outline or margin can be traced. Autumn colour is not a cause.
An old, mossy trunk in grass with flaking plates. It is taken from some distance, so the surface texture needs closer study.
A whole trunk with both edges visible and clear ridges and plates. A building and a lamp behind it are soft and do not compete.
A pale trunk with a branch and some moss, against bare trees and blue sky. The ridges are low and grey, so the pattern takes some searching. The busy background competes.
A texture-only close-up of vertical plates with no trunk edge, branch or scale object. A strong warm red cast, probably low sun, hides the true bark colour.
An old forked trunk seen from a distance in a woodland with autumn foliage. The bark is small in the frame and the background is busy.
A single ripe samara pair laid flat and shot from above on a plain purple ground, with a 1 cm scale bar. The top view is the angle cause. It is detached, so the hang cannot be seen.
A texture-only close-up of rough ridged bark with moss and lichen. It has no trunk edge, branch or scale object.
A texture-only close-up of grey ridged and plated bark. There is no trunk edge, branch or scale object.
A whole trunk with both edges in frame and a small leaf at upper left. Lichen blotches cover the bark, so the true colour needs study. The small file is sharp.

A pile of fallen autumn leaves in yellow, orange and brown that overlap each other. The central yellow-orange leaf is partly covered, so the lobes and margin need close study. Autumn colour is not a cause.

A single sugar maple samara lies on snow with its green radicle emerging, so it is germinating and not in its usual dispersal form. Kind and wing read clearly, and the fruit does not show how it hangs.
A wide, sharp view of a grey trunk with vertical scaly ridges and plates, with both trunk edges in frame. No hard factors.
Several lobed leaves hang under a branch and are seen from below against the sky. The central leaf is readable but others crowd it, and the low viewpoint is unusual.
One sharp, grey-green leaf underside fills the frame against a dark soft background, with rounded lobes and pale veins easy to read. The petiole and twig are not in view.
A leafy branch tip with overlapping lobed leaves and a small green acorn in sunlight. The leaves overlap and the lower ones run off the frame edge, so no single outline is whole.

A dense branch end of deeply lobed, bright green leaves over grass. The leaves overlap heavily and the lobes are small in the frame, so a learner finds the outline only by searching. A few lower leaves are readable, so it is not a pure mass.
A cluster of dry tan samaras hangs from long stalks against a soft bare-twig background. Warm low sun tints them orange, which changes the colour.
Two ripe acorns on a plain blue background, one bare nut and one with its warty cap, with a 1 cm scale bar. Both are in full view and sharp.
A wet leafy branch seen from above over mulch, with many overlapping lobed leaves. Several leaves show full outlines, but they crowd each other.
Green acorns with warty caps sit in a cluster on a twig among leaves. They have full shape but are not ripe, and the leaves around them compete for attention.
A dark grey trunk with vertical ridges and flaky plates, partly dappled by sun. Both trunk edges and a brick building are in frame.
A trunk in woodland with blocky grey-and-tan plates and some lichen at the top. The background is busy but soft.
A grey trunk with shallow ridges and scaly plates in even daylight, with both trunk edges and the ground in frame.
A whole tree shot looking up the trunk into the forked crown, so the main subject is the tree and not the bark. The bark is small and foreshortened.
Green samara nutlets with full-size tan wings hang on thin stalks against a soft background. The fruit is full shape but not ripe.
One sharp lobed leaf with several holes and small yellow-green galls near the lower right. The damage is inside the blade, and the lobes and edge stay readable.
A close view of a pale green acorn with a warty cap, partly hidden behind a large leaf in the foreground. It is not ripe and the leaf covers its lower part.
A cluster of green-nutlet samaras with tan wings hangs on a twig against a black background, which looks like flash. The wings overlap, so single outlines take a search.
A group of grey-green leaf undersides meets at one twig tip against a dark leaf background. Lobes and veins read well, but the leaves overlap and some run off the frame edge.
A tall, grey-brown trunk with vertical ridges and plates in even light, with trunk edges and a building in the background.
One green acorn with a warty cap sits on a twig in sharp focus, with leaves soft behind it. The acorn is full size but still green, so it is unripe and not the usual ripe look.
A heap of brown dead leaves on the ground with hard sun and deep shadow patches. The subject is dead brown leaf litter, and the outlines overlap and are broken by shadow, so the light is a cause.
A cluster of green acorns with warty caps on a twig, with lobed leaves around and a blurred hand at the upper left holding the branch. The acorns are full shape but green, so unripe.

One sharp green mature leaf seen from below against a forest background, with pointed bristle-tipped lobes and clear veins. The underside view and tilt make it an angle cause, and the leaf stalk is cut off at the left so the join to the twig is not shown.
A wide, sharp view of a large trunk with long vertical ridges and furrows. Both trunk edges and the ground are in the frame, so it is not too close, and a small tree tag at the left is not readable.

Bright new spring leaves with bristle-tipped lobes hang from a twig with small catkins, with a mossy trunk blurred behind. The leaves are young and translucent in backlight, and they overlap each other so the subject is not alone.
The camera looks straight up a dark trunk into the crown, so the ridges are foreshortened and hard to read. The view from below is the angle cause and the check bark_up_or_dark is yes.

Dark green mature leaves with pointed lobes, layered over each other in dappled light with a path behind. The leaves are crowded and small in the frame, so the bristle tips of the margin need a search.
Three or four green acorns with warty caps close together on a twig, large and sharp in the frame, with leaves behind. They are full shape but green, so unripe.

Four green leaves spread from one point against a mossy trunk. The outlines and veins are clear, but the lobe tips are small and the join with the twig is not shown, so margin and arrangement need a search. The cluster looks like a held sprig with no clear sign of a sucker shoot.
Green lobed leaves on a small stem seen from above over brown leaf litter. The leaves are distinct and not blended, but they are small in the frame so the edge detail needs a search.

Very young yellow-green crinkled leaves in backlight with long hanging catkins that compete with them. The leaves overlap and are small, so the lobes are found only with close study; the leaves are still readable at the right, so this is search and not a reject.
A dense crown of red autumn foliage and bare twigs filling the frame, with no single leaf to read. The main subject is a crown, so the part is other.

A sunlit tip of the branch with leaves turning orange and yellow-green against dark foliage. The lobed outlines are clear, the bristle tips are small, and the autumn colour makes it not the usual look but is not a cause.
Red autumn leaves on a branch against a soft dark spruce background. The leaves are small, soft and crowded, but a few lobed outlines can be traced with study, so shape and margin are search.

Large green lobed leaves seen from above on a small stem over leaf litter, with one small hole that does not change the outline. The lobes are readable, but the bristle tips are small, so margin needs a search.

A cluster of acorns with warty caps on a twig against a dark background, with strong saturated colour and a pink cast on the nuts, like a slide scan. The shapes are clear, and the colour shift is a light cause but not a heavy tint.
Overlapping green lobed leaves on a branch, with a thin trunk behind at the lower centre. The leaves are crowded and partly cover each other, so the margin detail needs a search and whole is false.
A whole tree with red autumn foliage among conifers in a forest scene. The main subject is the tree crown, so the part is other.
The camera looks up a tall trunk into a green crown. The ridges are readable in the lower part, but the view up into the crown makes the check bark_up_or_dark yes and the angle a cause.
View up into a crown of yellowing and green leaves that overlap into a mass; no single leaf outline can be traced. Taken from below, so angle; autumn colour makes it growth_stage autumn.
Sharp, evenly lit close view of deep vertical ridges and furrows. The frame shows texture only, no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so too_close.
A crown seen from below with several orange flowers among green leaves; no single leaf, bark or fruit is the subject, so part other.

Whole trunk with fine vertical furrows, covered in grey-green lichen patches that hide the ridge pattern in places. A street, a building and a car in the background compete, so alone is false and the pattern needs a search.
One ripe brown acorn hanging by its stalk from a twig stub, sharp against a soft green background. Cap and nut are fully visible.
Four acorns on a black background: a whole acorn with cap, a bare nut, a cap seen from above and a nut base. Plain background, nothing shows how the fruit hangs.
Dense branch of green mature leaves that overlap, with a small bud at the centre. A few outlines can be traced with study, so shape and margin are search and alone is false.

Low plants with broad, rounded-lobed leaves mixed with other vegetation, looking like seedling or sapling foliage that has not reached the typical mature shape. Leaves can be traced but other plants crowd the frame, so alone is false.
Crowded branch of green leaves seen from below, with one long green bud with a red tip at the centre. Leaves overlap and tilt, so the outlines need a search and the angle is unusual.
Close view of dark plates and furrows with yellow-orange lichen, lit by warm low sun that shifts the colour. The frame shows texture only, so too_close.
Whole grey trunk with long vertical ridges and shallow furrows, trunk edges visible at both sides, even daylight.
New spring shoot with folded, unexpanded leaves against blue sky, seen from below. The leaves have not reached full shape, so young, and they are partly folded, so the outline needs a search.
Seed-collection style photo on a blue background: an acorn with cap, a cut nut and a nut base, with a 1 cm scale bar. Nothing shows how the fruit hangs.
One whole green leaf with its lobes and entire margin in sharp view on a dark soft background. A few small spots do not change the outline.
Top of a crown against blue sky, seen from below; leaves are small and blend together, so no leaf, bark or fruit is the subject (part other).
Twig with two open yellow-orange flowers and a bud among large lobed leaves; the flowers are the main subject, so part other.
Three green, full-shape acorns sitting on twigs among leaves; the shape is full but the fruit is not ripe, so unripe. Twigs, buds and leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false.
One whole green leaf with clear lobes, entire margin and veins, lying on a soft background of fallen autumn leaves.
Leafy crown with many open orange-yellow flowers; flowers and a mass of leaves, no single leaf, bark or fruit as subject, so part other.
Five ripe brown acorns with caps on a plain pale background, shown from different sides. Nothing shows how the fruit hangs.
A crown seen against sky, with bare twigs, small yellow and brown leaves and clusters of dry fruit. No single leaf, fruit or bark area is the subject, so the part is other.

Tight view of deep interlacing ridges forming a diamond network, with some lichen. There is no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so the frame shows texture only (too_close). The pattern is easy to read.
A full trunk in sun with both edges visible, showing narrow ridges and pale furrows. The background is soft and does not compete.

The base of a very large trunk in a forest, seen from a distance and in deep shade, with thin saplings and leaf litter around it. The ridges can be traced only with close study, so the bark features are search, and shade is the cause.

Frosted dry cones of samaras on a bare twig against a soft blue background. The central cone is sharp and sits upright on its twig; the wings are packed together and need a closer look. Colours are vivid but the tree looks real.
Several trunks in a bare winter wood. The pale furrowed bark shows, but strong cast shadows, one dark trunk and a vine compete, so the ridge pattern needs study. Shadow is the cause.
Two dry upright cones of samaras on a bare twig against autumn foliage. They are small in the frame, so the fruit kind is search; the outline and the way they sit on the twig are readable.
A whole tree seen from below, with the trunk, limbs and green crown. No single leaf, fruit or bark area is the subject, so the part is other.
One dry cone of samaras held up on a twig against a blue sky, with bare branches behind. Sharp and isolated; the individual wings are tight and need a closer look.
A top view of an opened fruit on snow, with the wings spread out like a rosette around the central spike. The top view and the broken form hide the usual spindle shape; the way it hangs is not shown.
Tight view of vertical ridges and furrows with yellow-green lichen. No trunk edge, branch or scale object is in the frame, so it shows texture only (too_close). The ridges are sharp.
A dry cone of samaras against a black background, lit by flash. The fruit is sharp and complete; only a stub of twig shows, so the hang is not shown. Flash changes the colour.
Two children stand in front of a very large trunk in a forest, each holding a small leaf. The main subject is the scene, not a leaf, a fruit or a bark area.
A whole trunk with both edges visible, showing ridges with pale furrows. The background is soft and dark green, and the bark reads well.
A trunk in side light against dark foliage, with ridges and furrows easy to read. Both trunk edges show.
A sunlit trunk with long ridges and pale furrows, trunk edges visible, a few leaves at the sides. Sharp and easy to read.
A weathered old fruit lying on the ground among dry grass, clover and litter, seen from above. The clutter competes, the scales are faded, and it does not hang on a twig.
A ripe dry cone of samaras on a twig with autumn leaves and a green leaf behind. The fruit is sharp, with the spread wings and the twig attachment visible, and the background is soft.
A large dry cone of samaras held upright on a twig against a soft green background. Sharp, whole, and the wings and the twig attachment are clear.
A green unripe fruit of full shape on a twig, among green leaves. The tight green scales hide the fruit kind, which needs study, and the wings are not yet visible.
Large leaf seen from below and tilted, backlit so it turns yellow-green, with its bottom tip at the frame edge and other leaves behind it. Outline and teeth can be traced only with study.
Several green leaves on a twig against a dark autumn background; the upper left leaf is whole and its lobes and teeth read well. Other leaves and twigs crowd the frame.
Cluster of leaves turning red, orange and yellow on one stem against sky. The top left leaf is whole; the leaves overlap each other and the bottom ones are cut by the frame.
Pale mottled trunk shot from below at a fork, with bare branches crossing the frame against sky. The patchy pattern shows clearly, but the view is from below and the branches compete.
One bright green leaf with sharp lobes and teeth against soft grass; a twig with more leaves sits above it. Clear and well framed.
One large leaf with a long stalk on grass, with partial leaves at the left and bottom. Outline, teeth and veins read well and the leaf stalk does not reach a twig.
Two overlapping grey-green leaves held in a hand beside a trunk, with leaf litter around. The leaves overlap, the hand reaches the edge of one, and the margin is soft.
Green leaf lit by flash against black, with brown blotches on it and on the leaf above. Other leaves overlap its top and its right tip touches the frame edge, so it is not whole.
Dry cone of samaras standing upright on a twig in snow, with the wings fanned open and many already gone. The fruit and its attachment are clear on a plain background.
Close view of mottled bark in green, grey, cream and brown, with peeling patches. The frame holds texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object.
Trunk base beside a street, shaded and dark with only a few pale patches and a lot of street scene around it. The pattern shows only with study, and the shade dulls the colour.
Bare crown against blue sky with a few tiny dry fruit cones far off. The main subject is the branches, so the part is other.
Fresh light green leaf in sharp focus with a small flower head and new leaves at the top, which marks spring. Other leaves overlap and fill the frame, and a few small holes do not change the outline.
Sapling or crown of leaves that blend into one mass. No single leaf shows its outline or margin.
Bare winter crown seen from below with many branches against sky. The main subject is the whole crown, so the part is other.
Old forked trunk with a hollow, its pale mottled patches clear, in summer greenery. Foliage and the hollow share the frame, and the texture reads only with study.
Leafy twig laid flat on a plain grey deck, showing the leaf stalks joining the twig. Several leaves are whole with clear lobes and teeth, and the frame cuts off a few.
Trunk with peeling cream and brown patches, with branches crossing it and dry reeds behind. The light is warm and low, which shifts the colour.
Dull dark green leaf with black specks, partly covered by other leaves on its left, in dim light. The lobes and the faint margin can be traced only with study.

Pale, stippled green leaf with sharp lobes and teeth against soft gravel, with a few leaves cut by the top edge. Outline and margin are clear; the leaf stalk leaves the frame so the twig is not shown.
A green, full-shape spiky seed ball on its stalk against a plain leaf. It is not ripe, so usual_look is false. The stalk shows but the twig does not, so hang needs a search.

A large green planetree leaf held by a hand, with the right lobe and the top cut off by the frame. Other leaves crowd the background, and a small hole and a gall-like lesion on the edge change the outline slightly. The source name is the hybrid itself, so it passes.
A bare tree with pale mottled limbs, seen from below against blue sky. The main subject is the whole tree and crown, so the part is other. The view from below is an unusual angle.
Many small brown seed balls scattered on bare twigs against sky. Each ball is small in the frame, so kind, shape and hang need a search.
Five brown ripe seed balls hang on long stalks from a bare twig against a plain blue sky. Kind, shape and hang read clearly.
Mottled bark with grey-green, cream and olive plates flaking away, with a knob on the trunk. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so too_close is true.

A spent, honeycomb-pitted seed ball that lies on a log and is seen from above, with a second broken piece beside it. The ball has shed its seeds and no longer has the typical spiky look, so the kind needs a search.

A street tree trunk seen from a distance at its base, with a curb, grass and the edge of a car in the frame. The bark pattern is small and dark and needs a search, and the scene competes with the trunk.
A small young seed ball hangs on its stalk from a twig with fresh spring leaf growth above it, against a soft green background. It has not reached full size, so it is young and not the usual look.
A trunk with pale mottled plates and a branch scar. Leaves and yellow foliage overlap the trunk at the sides and bottom, so the subject is not alone.
A tree-lined path with leafy trees in summer. The main subject is a scene and not a leaf, bark or fruit, so the part is other. The source name is the hybrid itself, so it passes.
A full-shape yellow-green seed ball hangs on a long stalk from a twig against blue sky. It is not ripe brown, so usual_look is false.
A green seed ball hangs on a stalk in front of soft autumn-coloured leaves. The ball is full shape but not ripe, and the twig is out of frame, so hang needs a search.
A whole tree seen from below, with a pale trunk and spreading limbs among summer leaves. The main subject is the whole tree and crown, so the part is other. The upward view is an unusual angle.
A spent seed ball with a dark core and a ring of fluffy seed hairs, seen from above on a log. It is a broken, shed form, so kind and shape need a search.
Many brown ripe seed balls hang on thin stalks from bare twigs against blue sky. The balls are fairly small in the frame but still readable.
A seed ball that is breaking apart, with a fluffy mass of seed hairs showing at its centre, against a soft background. It is a shed, broken form. The twig is out of frame, so hang needs a search.
A small green seed ball hangs on a long stalk from a bare twig with dormant buds, against a soft background. The ball is green and not the usual ripe brown, so usual_look is false.
A trunk with pale and tan bark peeling in flakes, with the trunk edges and woods behind it. The pattern and texture read clearly.
A large ripe brown spiky seed ball fills the frame against sky and bare branches. Only a short stalk shows at the top, so hang needs a search.
Leafy branch in shade with a car and street behind. The centre leaf shows its lobed outline, but leaves overlap and the edge needs close study, so alone is false and margin is search.
Trunk with peeling plates in pale and brown patches. Both trunk edges show, so the frame is not too close.
Sunlit leaves overlap with a trunk and wires in the frame. The bright light washes out colour and the leaf outlines need close study.
Whole trunk width with flaking plates in olive, cream and brown. Trunk edges show against the background.
Rough, flaking bark with deep shadow across the right half. The texture reads, but shadow hides the plate pattern and colour. There is no trunk edge, so the frame is too close.
Trunk with blotchy cream and brown plates. Trunk edges show and a building is behind it. The trunk is still the main subject.
Close view of smooth bark with green, yellow and brown patches. No trunk edge or branch shows, so the frame is texture only.
Brown fallen leaf on grass with other dead leaves around it. The left edge of the leaf is cut by the frame. The subject is a dead brown leaf.
Camera looks up a forked trunk into bare branches. The trunk is dark against the bright sky, so the bark pattern is hard to read.
Smooth trunk with large grey-green and cream patches. Trunk edges show against green foliage.
Close view of peeling plates in low warm sun with a long shadow. The warm light shifts the colour. No trunk edge shows, so the frame is texture only.
One large green lobed leaf against the trunk. A hand shows at the top, and the right lobe touches the frame edge, so whole is false.
Tree-lined street scene with cyclists and cars. The main subject is a scene, not a leaf, bark or fruit.
Green-brown seed balls hang on twigs, seen from below against blue sky. The balls are small in the frame and leaves compete. No two balls show clearly on one stalk.
Green leaf held in a hand, showing the underside with raised veins. The fingers cover the lower left of the blade, so whole is false. The hand gives scale.
Dense foliage fills the frame and the leaves blend into a mass. No single leaf outline can be traced without close study.
One sharp green leaf with pointed lobes and toothed edge on a dark background. A smaller leaf and the stalk and twig show at the lower left, but the leaf stalk join is partial.
Lobed leaves on a twig in front of a mottled trunk. The trunk pattern competes with the leaves. The scene is dim with low contrast and a colour cast, so the leaf edge needs close study.
Whole trunk with a fine network of small cream and grey plates. Trunk edges show against the background.
Trunk covered with grey-green lichen over peeling plates, with leaf litter and a pavement behind. Lichen hides the plate pattern and the bark colour, so both need close study.
A brown dry seed ball held in a hand against fallen autumn leaves; the whole ball and its spiky outline are clear. The hand holds it, so hang is not shown, and only one ball is present.
Two tan seed balls hang one above the other against blue sky with bare twigs. The stalk joining them is partly hidden behind the upper ball, so a learner has to look to confirm both sit on one stalk.
A small green young seed ball on a stalk held below a hand, with large leaves and a big hand competing in the frame. The ball is small in the frame and not full size, so shape needs close study.

A seed ball on paving that has begun to break up, with loose fluffy seeds beside it. It is seen from above on the ground, so the form is atypical and the angle is unusual, and the fruit kind needs a closer look.
A full-size green spiky seed ball hangs on a long stalk among plane leaves. It is not yet ripe, so it is not the usual brown look; only one ball is shown.
A single green seed ball hangs from a long thin stalk against a soft green background. The ball is sharp and full size but still green, so it is unripe.
Pale green-tan seed balls hang in a chain on one stalk below a big leaf; two balls and the stalk between them show clearly, with a third behind. The balls are not yet brown, so they are unripe.
A dense mass of overlapping plane leaves on branches, with a few tiny brown fruits that are not the subject. Only one or two leaves can be traced, with some effort, so the leaves blend into a mass.
A small yellow-green seed ball on a thin stalk lit by warm low sun, in front of a trunk and autumn leaves. The ball is small in the frame among branches and shadow, so its features need close study.
A dark brown seed ball seen from below against bright leaves, so it reads as a backlit dark round shape. The outline and hang are clear, but the spiky surface is hard to see in the shade.

Several brown seed balls on bare twigs with buds, seen from below against blue sky, so they are dark and backlit. The sharp ball on the right shows its kind and outline, and the balls are on separate stalks.

Several red autumn leaves on crossing sprigs, crowded and overlapping, with the frame cutting some leaves. Lobes and margins read only with close study, so they are search, not no. Autumn colour is not a cause.

Dense cluster of green mature lobed leaves on a sprig, overlapping and cut by the frame. The leaves stay distinct enough to trace, so the leaf is not a mass. Crowding gives alone false and search on the key features.

Yellow, orange and red autumn leaves in a crowded cluster against a busy background of other foliage. The leaf outlines are visible but small, so the key features are search. The colour is autumn, not a cause.

Tall moss-covered trunk on a grassy slope, filling the frame with the crown cut off at the top. Moss hides much of the ridge pattern, so texture and pattern read only from a distance, which is search. The trunk edges are in view, so it is not too close.

Foreground yellow autumn leaves in a cluster, with a red tree and a white building behind against a blue sky. The background competes, so alone is false. The leaf outlines are small and crowded, so they are search.

Sprig of red and orange autumn leaves, with the central leaf lobes readable. The other leaves overlap, and asters sit at the bottom edge of the frame. Flowers do not take the place of the leaf feature, so there is no reject.

One whole green mature leaf on a red stalk, sharp against a dark soft background. The lobes, the toothed margin and the veins all read clearly. The stalk joins the twig off the frame, so arrangement is search.
